generator.seed_rule: identity = f'id_{i:08d}' for i in 0..; payload = f'payload_{i:08d}'; lineage = f'lineage_{i:08d}'

special_placements.id_r1: fixed at position 0 (always first record for all N >= 64)
special_placements.all_other: sequential deterministic ids starting from id_00000005

generator.digest: SHA-256 of canonical serialisation of each X_N
